scenario:
Ticket INC-20419: The network team wants to send six months of call recordings from the Kandy contact queue to Lankatel Analytics so they can tune their speech-to-text engine. Upul says the vendor will start on Friday and the processing agreement is still with Legal for review. Files will go over SFTP. Please open the firewall rule today.
Raised by: Fathima Rizvi, IT Operations

answer.rationale: The vendor would receive call recordings while the processing agreement is still with Legal, so no signed contract binds it. Using the recordings to tune the vendor's speech engine is also a new purpose that callers were not told about.
issues: Call recordings would go to Lankatel Analytics on Friday while the processing agreement is still under Legal review.
The recordings would be used to tune the vendor's speech-to-text engine, a purpose not stated when the calls were recorded.
required_actions: Hold the firewall change until the processing agreement is signed.
Get DPO review of the speech-engine tuning purpose before any transfer.

scenario:
Subject: Back-to-school push for Little Saver accounts
Team, we plan to send app notifications and SMS to all 9,200 Little Saver account holders aged 12 to 17, promoting the new teen debit card. Messages would go straight to the children's own phone numbers on file. Parents will not be copied. Kasun from Digital has the creatives ready for launch next Tuesday.
Regards, Dilrukshi Fernando

answer.rationale: The campaign targets account holders aged 12 to 17, who are minors under the policy. The policy does not allow marketing aimed at minors, and the messages would reach the children directly with no guardian involved.
issues: Promotional messages would target 9,200 minor account holders aged 12 to 17.
Messages would go directly to the children's phone numbers with parents not copied.
required_actions: Cancel the teen debit card push to minor account holders.
Send any product information to parents or guardians with recorded consent instead.
Consult the DPO before relaunching the campaign.

scenario: Minutes, Galle branch operations meeting, item 3: New savings accounts will continue to need a copy of the NIC because KYC rules oblige the Bank to verify identity. answer.rationale: The NIC copy is collected because KYC rules require identity verification, so the lawful basis is a legal obligation. Scans are encrypted with role-based access, paper copies are shredded and the form carries the privacy notice.
required_actions: Keep role-based access to the document system under periodic review.
Continue shredding paper copies straight after scanning.

scenario: Proposal extract, part 4: CloudLedger will host the Bank's statement archive, about 2.1 million customer statements, on its managed platform from next quarter. Data is encrypted at rest and in transit, access uses named accounts with MFA, and the Bank keeps the keys. The vendor's standard processing agreement is attached for signature. Support staff work from the vendor's regional operations centre.

answer.rationale: The proposal covers encryption, access control and a processing agreement. It does not say in which country the statements will be hosted or where the support centre is, and a transfer outside Sri Lanka would need a DPO-approved transfer assessment first.
missing_information: In which country will the statement archive be hosted?
Where is the vendor's regional operations centre that will access the data?
required_actions: Ask the vendor to confirm hosting and support locations in writing.
Complete a transfer assessment with the DPO if any location is outside Sri Lanka.

required_actions: Filter the list to customers with a recorded email marketing opt-in.
